2123088477868736729.en_summary: $Tencent / Chinese CSPs’ tone on the AI capex cycle is very clear. Martin Lau laid out a clear case for why AI capex should moderate after 2027: 1/ Front-loaded investment: AI infrastructure is like building a factory. Once built, it can continuously train new models and generate tokens. 2/ Lower hardware costs: The same equipment should cost significantly less by 2028. 3/ Rapid efficiency gains.
2123088477868736729.zh_summary: $Tencent／中國雲服務提供商對AI資本支出週期的語氣非常清晰。Martin Lau清楚說明為何AI資本支出應在2027年後放緩：1／前置投資：AI基礎設施如建廠，一旦建成可持續訓練新模型並生成tokens。2／硬件成本降低：相同設備到2028年應顯著更便宜。3／快速效率提升。

2123088283718885542.en_summary: We are there ($152), after two years of gains removed. But is that enough of a discount? Remember: Investors aren't pricing in what $NVDA earned under Jensen, but what they will earn moving forward without him. That's a big ask. And most certainly not a safe bet.
2123088283718885542.zh_summary: 我們到了（152美元），兩年的漲幅已被抹去。但這是否足夠的折扣？記住：投資者不是在定價$NVDA在Jensen下賺了什麼，而是未來沒有他將賺什麼。這是很大的要求。而且肯定不是安全的賭注。
